steps.title: Sign in to Google Sheets
steps.why: Your contacts stay in your own Google account.
instructions: Follow the guide the agent reads for you
Open the page that 'installer secret google' printed and sign in
Tell the agent when the page says Done

steps.title: Check that the Google sign-in works
steps.why: Proves the sign-in and the Sheets API.
steps.intent: Nothing to do before the check: run its verify. If it fails, tell the person its hint word for word, then verify again.
